unverified.indexer: Blockfrost hosts the indexer and does not report its version; 4.3.302 is the Midnight-published Preprod indexer and stays unverified until the hosted endpoint reports it.

network.name: preprod
network.authentication: project_id query parameter attached at runtime from a secret store; the token is never committed, bundled, or logged

accounts.public: Chain Data Proxy only; token in that Render service's secret store
accounts.operator: Sponsor Service, Automation Service, and Operator CLI; locally the Keychain entry named by MIDNIGHT_BLOCKFROST_SECRET_NAME (service com.shroudly.preprod.blockfrost, account shroudly-preprod)

network.browserReads: Chain Data Proxy serves pre-connect and public contract-state reads; after connect, participant reads use the wallet's getConfiguration() endpoints first and fall back to the proxy

notes: walletSdk 1.2.0 is the @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk facade kept while the testkit stays on 4.x; npm latest (1.1.0) is older.
Do not take npm latest for compact-runtime (0.20.0), platform-js (3.0.0; midnight-js pins 2.2.4), or ledger-v8 (8.1.3; midnight-js pins 8.1.0).
The @midnight-ntwrk to @midnightntwrk package scope migration is pending; the pins above keep the current scopes until that change lands.
zkKeysGenerated and contractIntegrationAttested stay false until the private offline integration re-runs against proof server 8.1.3.
